name: Shadow Style
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja gains a shadow style selection from the list of shadow styles normally available to the shadow assassin. The ninja must meet any prerequisites of the style, and treats her ninja level as her shadow assassin level. This trick may be taken more than once, but not more than once per 3 ninja levels.
